name.la: Praefationes, De recognitione operis et Controversiae generales
name.en-US: Prefaces, the Recognition of the Work and the General Controversies
name.pt-BR: Prefácios, Revisão da obra e Controvérsias gerais

description.la: Ex Disputationibus de controversiis christianae fidei adversus huius temporis haereticos (1586-93): Praefationes, De recognitione operis et Controversiae generales. Textus ex editione Vivès (1870-74), ex scanno OCR.
description.en-US: From the Disputations on the Controversies of the Christian Faith (1586-93): the editor's and the author's prefaces, the author's own review of the work and the introduction to the general controversies. Latin only: the Vivès edition (1870-74) from an OCR scan.
description.pt-BR: Das Disputas sobre as controvérsias da fé cristã (1586-93): Prefácios, Revisão da obra e Controvérsias gerais.

sources.edition: Roberti Bellarmini Opera omnia, ed. Justin Fèvre, tom. 1 (Paris: Vivès, 1870-74).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.txt, Boston College copy) cleaned by script: running heads, page numbers and the reference-only footnote blocks removed, line-end hyphens joined, recognisable OCR slips corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bellarmine died in 1621; the Vivès edition of 1870-74 is public domain.
